name: 日付ごとの予定一覧
prompt:
Create a single corrective attempt 2 by editing Image 1, the existing LH04-0002 Japanese date schedule candidate. Preserve its successful composition and use the exact 390:290 component aspect ratio.

Only correct these observed issues:
1. Keep the completed Tuesday card for 「料理を楽しむ会」 pure white like the other ordinary cards. Remove the broad pale-coral interior fill and coral card border. Preserve the small coral flag as its semantic completion cue and retain the legible title strikethrough.
2. Match the verified native typography: weekdays 火/水 use Meiryo Regular 12px/16px; dates 25/26 Meiryo Regular 20px/28px; event names Meiryo Regular 14px/24px; times Meiryo Regular 12px/16px; tracking 0. The current weekday labels and event names look too heavy. Keep dates and times regular as they are. Preserve the simple size hierarchy and Japanese glyph forms.

Keep every other successful detail from Image 1: top-edge partial current-time line and dot; date grouping; the green forest selected-date marker for 25; slate utility glyphs; all four events, their exact order, icons and times; the reminder/hand glyph beside each 「地域交流の集い」; the flag and strike-through on the completed Tuesday event; white page and ordinary cards; thin quiet neutral borders; exact compact geometry and spacing.

Exact Japanese content:
火 25 — 「地域交流の集い」, 「13:00」; 「料理を楽しむ会」, 「14:00–15:00」 (completed, flag plus title strikethrough).
水 26 — 「祝日」; 「地域交流の集い」, 「13:00」.

Image 2 is the assigned source crop for original icon silhouettes and completed/reminder states. Image 3 is the Japanese mock for exact copy and the 390x290 frame. Preserve the existing icons; do not add, remove, or redesign them. Use pure white interiors for every card. Use coral only for the small completion flag, not as a broad surface tint. Do not add green/mint card fills, background washes, extra copy, dates, events, device chrome, or controls.

Return only the corrected 390x290 component. Do not make unrelated changes.
reviewNotes: Attempt 2 selected after comparison: the completed event has a white interior with only its small coral flag and the title strike-through. Exact copy, four rows, reminder glyphs, dates, times, and selected-date marker are retained. Remaining needs-correction: card width is about 364px versus the 354px mock, and weekday/event titles still appear heavier than verified Meiryo Regular.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
